Name: Joash, King of Israel
Summary: Joash, son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu and king of Israel, answered Amaziah's challenge with the parable of the thistle and the cedar, defeated Judah at Beth-shemesh, broke down Jerusalem's wall, and took the temple treasures to Samaria.
KeyStory: Joash warned Amaziah to abide at home, but Amaziah would not hear, and Judah was put to the worse before Israel.
RelatedPeople: Amaziah, King of Judah; Jehoahaz, Son of Jehu
LifeLesson: Pride after a victory can provoke a defeat far worse than the first battle.
